help.title: About this demonstration
help.intro: Nidz is a prototype. Here is precisely what works, what is simulated, and what does not exist yet.

what.a: Describe your animal and your dates, browse sitters, open a profile, send a request, create your own sitter profile and answer requests. All of that genuinely works — but only inside this browser.

data.a: Nowhere. Nidz has no server: everything you type stays in this browser's local storage, and nothing is sent. No SMS is sent, no file is uploaded, no account is created anywhere else.

verification.a: No, and no profile shows “verified identity”. Nidz has no verification process today. Everything on a profile is presented as stated by that person. There are no reviews, ratings or statistics either: nothing produces them.

booking.q: Is an accepted request a booking?
booking.a: No. Nidz handles no reservation, no payment and no insurance, and has not decided how it will. Accepting a request means a person agreed — everything else is arranged directly between the two people.

sitters.a: No. They are examples written for the demonstration, marked as such in the results and on their profiles. There are no photographs of real people and no real accounts. The only non-fictional profile possible is the one you build yourself.

coverage.a: Nidz lists all 69 wilayas of Algeria and their 1,541 communes. For the wilayas redrawn in 2019 and 2026, communes are assigned as laws 19-12 and 26-06, published in the Journal Officiel, set out; elsewhere the 1984 division is taken from an open dataset, and not every name has been checked against the Journal Officiel yet. That is a description of the DATA, not of the marketplace: the sitters in this demonstration are examples, and there is no real supply anywhere. Algeria's territorial division also changes — it went from 48 wilayas to 58 in 2019 and to 69 in 2026 — so this list is reference data to keep up to date, never a constant.

policies.title: Data and privacy
policies.intro: This page describes what the prototype actually does with what you type. It is not a privacy policy: there is no service behind it to have one.

points.storage: What you save is kept in this browser's local storage, under a single key; a form you started but have not saved yet is kept there separately, as a draft, until you save or discard it — or it no longer applies (an animal deleted, a request decided). Nothing is kept anywhere else.
points.transmit: No data is transmitted: Nidz has no server, no database and no third-party service in this prototype.
points.location: The location asked for is a commune, never an address. Nidz collects no exact address and does not use your device's geolocation.
points.documents: An identity document is never uploaded: only the file name is kept, locally, and it produces no verification.
points.photos: Photos you add stay on your device and disappear when the page is reloaded.
points.remove: You can erase everything at any time from Settings.

enrich.body: Optional. It helps owners picture how you look after animals. A fuller profile is not a verified one, and nothing ranks on it.
enrich.count_one: {{count}} of {{total}} filled in, if you wish.
enrich.count_other: {{count}} of {{total}} filled in, if you wish.

identity.label: Your public name and area
identity.hint: First name and initial; your wilaya and, if you like, your commune — never an address.

sitterSections.missingPublished: Your profile is published, but it is now missing the following, so it is not shown in search results until you add it:

sitterExperience.intro: Concrete questions rather than a number of years. Leave anything blank that you are not sure about — a blank question shows nowhere on your profile, whereas a “no” you did not mean reads to an owner as a firm limit.
sitterExperience.demoNote: Answers here are yours alone. Nothing is checked and nothing is scored.

puppiesKittens.label: Have you looked after puppies or kittens?

seniors.label: Have you looked after older animals?

specialNeeds.label: Have you looked after an animal with special needs?

oralMedication.label: Can you give medication by mouth?

multipleAnimals.label: Have you looked after several animals at once?

reactiveAnimals.label: Have you handled a reactive or anxious animal?

paidBefore.label: Have you been paid to look after animals before?

sitterProfessional.intro: If you work or study in an animal-related field, say so here. Nidz cannot check any of it, so this stays a statement by you — it produces no badge and changes nothing about where you appear.
sitterProfessional.demoNote: Naming a profession verifies nothing. Nidz has no way to confirm a qualification, and your profile will say that plainly.
sitterProfessional.kindLabel: Do you work or study in an animal-related field?
sitterProfessional.detailHelp: Your role, where, and what it involves. Owners read this, so keep it concrete.
sitterProfessional.evidenceLabel: Could you show a document if Nidz ever asked?
sitterProfessional.evidenceHelp: Answering yes changes nothing today. There is no verification process, and no document is requested or stored.

sitterCare.intro: This is the part of you an owner cannot guess from a photo, a price or a commune. Two people can both be good with animals and run completely different homes. Answer what applies and leave the rest.
sitterCare.demoNote: Everything here is your own description of your own home. Nothing is checked, nothing is scored, and answering more of it does not move you up the results.
sitterCare.containmentReasonRequired: Please say why you use a crate or cage. On its own the fact is easy to misread, in both directions.
sitterCare.movementLabel: Where can a visiting animal go?

sleeping.ownQuietRoom: In a quiet room of its own

sitterCare.containmentIntro: Some sitters use a crate, a pen or a cage and some never do. Neither is a problem here — being unclear about it is. An owner needs to know before the stay, not on the day.
sitterCare.containmentLabel: Do you use a crate, a pen or a cage?
sitterCare.containmentReasonLabel: Why, and what it is like
sitterCare.containmentReasonHelp: Twenty minutes in an open crate and a whole night shut in are not the same thing. Say which yours is.
sitterCare.presenceLabel: Who is at home during the day?

presence.mostOfDay: I am there most of the day

sitterCare.maxHoursAloneLabel: Longest the animal would be alone (hours)
sitterCare.maxHoursAloneHelp: On a normal day, not the worst one.
sitterCare.enrichmentLabel: What does a day actually look like?
sitterCare.enrichmentHelp: Play, company, going out. A few sentences in your own words.

dog.walksHelp: Zero is a real answer — say it if it is yours.
dog.offLeashLabel: Do you let a dog off the lead?
dog.offLeashHelp: Owners of a dog that runs need to know this one.
dog.gardenLabel: Does a visiting dog get into your outdoor space?

cat.indoorLabel: Do you keep a visiting cat indoors?
cat.hidingHelp: A cat with nowhere to retreat to in a strange home is the most common reason a stay goes badly.

bird.outOfCageLabel: Hours out of the cage a day
bird.flightSafeLabel: Is there a room that is safe to fly in?
bird.flightSafeHelp: Windows shut, fans off, no other animal in the room.
bird.coversLabel: Do you cover the cage at night?

sitterCare.transportLabel: How would you get an animal somewhere?
sitterCare.canReachVetLabel: Could you get an animal to a vet?
sitterCare.canReachVetHelp: A straight no is useful. An owner would rather know now than find out during an emergency.
sitterCare.emergencyPlanLabel: What would you do if something went wrong?
sitterCare.emergencyPlanHelp: Who you would call, in what order, and how you would get there.

clarify.title: Questions before deciding
clarify.localNote: Kept in this browser only. Nobody was notified and no message was sent.

suggest.meet: Could we meet before the stay, so I can get to know your animal?
suggest.otherAnimals: How does your animal get on with other animals?
suggest.routine: What does a normal day look like for your animal (meals, walks, sleep)?

clarify.notSent: This is not sent: it is added to this request in this browser, where the other side of this demonstration can read it. The request stays awaiting a reply.
clarify.waitingOwner: Your question is on the request. It is still awaiting your decision: asking accepts nothing.
clarify.questionForYou: The sitter has a question before deciding. The request is still awaiting a reply.
clarify.exampleNoInbox: This sitter is an example: nobody can read or answer a question addressed to them, so none is offered here.

save.failedBody: Nothing was saved: this browser couldn't keep it (storage full or blocked, in a private window for example). What you typed is still here, so you can try again.
save.conflictTitle: This information changed in the meantime.
save.conflictBody: It was edited elsewhere — in another tab or on another screen — since you started this form, and nothing has been saved here. Saving your version will replace the other one; using the saved version will discard what you typed here.
save.draftRestored: We found what you had started typing. It isn't saved yet.
save.conflictBodySingle: It changed elsewhere — in another tab or on another screen — since you opened this screen, and nothing has been saved here. Show the saved version to carry on.

local.title: On this device only
local.body: Messages stay in this browser: nobody receives them, and Nidz cannot know whether anyone has read them.

owner.title: No conversations yet
owner.body: Before asking for care, ask a sitter a question from their profile.

sitter.title: No messages
sitter.body: Questions owners write to your profile on this device will appear here.

thread.contextNote: As it was when the conversation started.
thread.noticeExample: {{name}} is an example profile: nobody will read this conversation.
thread.noticeOwn: This is your own sitter profile: you can answer from your sitter space, on this device. Nothing leaves it.
thread.noticeSitter: Written on this device from the owner space of the same account. Your reply stays here too: nobody receives it.

composer.label: Your message — stays on this device
composer.cannotReply: Only {{name}}'s own space could answer here — it does not exist on this device.

notFound.title: This conversation is not here
notFound.body: It may have been erased with the demo data, or it belongs to another space.

notifications.note: What Nidz would tell you. Here nothing is sent: no SMS, no e-mail, no notification on your phone.

empty.title: Nothing new
empty.body: Replies, questions and decisions on your requests will be listed here.

notifications.question: A question about {{pet}} is waiting for your answer

spaces.title: Your two spaces
spaces.body: One account, two ways of using Nidz. Switching changes what you see; it deletes nothing — not your animals, your requests, a request you are preparing, or your sitter profile.
spaces.current: The space you are using now
spaces.sitterDraft: Your profile is not published yet — continue it
spaces.sitterNone: Look after animals: describe what you offer
spaces.sitterHidden: Your profile no longer appears in results — complete it

help.title: Help and safety
help.helpLine: What works, what is simulated, and what does not exist yet.
help.policiesLine: What happens to everything you type.

guest.title: You are browsing without an account
guest.body: Searching and reading profiles needs nothing. An account, kept on this device, is what lets you send a request or a message.

pets.empty: Describe your animal once; it is ready for every request.

publicProfile.title: My public profile
publicProfile.line: What owners see when they find you

sitterProfile.title: My sitter profile
sitterProfile.previewLine: See your profile as owners will

status.hidden: No longer visible — something is missing

catalogue.noMatch: Nothing in the list matches “{{query}}”. Use “Other” to type it.

start.title: Welcome, {{name}}. Where would you like to start?

register.title: Open an account
register.intro: One account for both spaces: finding care for your animals and offering it.
register.demoBody: Google, Apple and SMS are not connected in this version. The screens show the planned journey; nothing is sent to any service, no identity is checked, and your account stays in this browser.

existing.title: An account already exists on this device: {{name}}
existing.body: This prototype keeps one account per browser. Sign in to it, or erase this device's data to start again.
existing.eraseBody: The account, animals, requests, published requests and sitter profile kept in this browser will be erased. Nothing exists on a server, so nothing else is affected. This cannot be undone.

name.title: Your name
name.intro: Your first name and the initial of your last name are what others see.
name.providerBody: In the final version, {{provider}} would fill in your name here. In this prototype, type it yourself — you can change it at any time.

phone.title: Your phone number
phone.intro: Needed to open an account. It is never shown to other members.
phone.label: Mobile number

code.title: Confirmation code
code.label: Code sent to {{phone}}
code.demoBody: This prototype is connected to no SMS service, so no code was sent. To continue the demonstration, type any six digits. Your number will be recorded as not verified.

photo.title: Your profile photo
photo.intro: Optional. A photo helps people recognise you; you can add one later.
photo.label: Profile photo

login.title: Sign in

via.phone: Account opened with a phone number (prototype)

login.noneBody: In this prototype an account lives in the browser where it was opened. An account opened on another phone cannot be reached from here.
login.demoBody: Signing in reopens the account kept in this browser. No password, provider or code is checked: there is no server yet.

photo.localNote: Kept on this device only, reduced in size. Never uploaded.
photo.errorType: This file is not an image (JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC).
photo.errorRead: This image could not be read. Try another one.

pet.title: Your animal
pet.question: Which animal are you looking for care for?
pet.addQuestion: Which animal do you want to add?
pet.otherHelp: No sitter is assumed to accept an animal outside the list: you will confirm with them.
pet.otherRequired: Say which animal it is (2 to 40 characters).

breed.otherRequired: Type at least 2 characters, or choose “I don't know”.
breed.note: Optional. Some sitters accept only certain breeds or species: knowing it lets them answer. A breed says nothing about behaviour.

needs.title: Important needs and constraints
needs.question: Does your animal have special needs or important constraints?
needs.questionFor: Does {{name}} have special needs or important constraints?
needs.info: This is what a sitter needs to know before saying yes: a daily medication, an allergy, fear of other animals, a special diet. It is shown to the sitters you ask or who see your published request — never on a public page.
needs.placeholder: E.g. allergies, daily medication, anxiety, reactivity, special diet, difficulty with other animals, other important instructions…
needs.privacy: Seen by the sitters you ask, before they accept. Do not write an address or a phone number.

location.intro: Nidz shows the sitters nearest to the area you are looking in first.
location.privacyInfo: If you choose by hand, Nidz never asks for your position. With “Near me”, your device's position is used once, here, to suggest the nearest wilaya — it is neither stored nor sent.
location.methodLabel: How do you want to give the area?
location.manualHint: Wilaya, and commune if you like.
location.nearbyHint: Uses your device's location, once, when you ask.
location.askHint: Your browser will ask for permission. You can refuse and choose by hand.
location.found: Nearest wilaya to your position (estimate): {{wilaya}}. Check it below — you can change it.

error.denied: Location access was refused. You can allow it in your browser settings, or choose by hand.
error.unavailable: Your position could not be determined.
error.timeout: Finding your position took too long.
error.unsupported: This browser cannot give a position here.
error.outside: Your position seems to be outside Algeria. Choose the area by hand.

care.onlyRelevant: Only the services suited to {{animal}} are offered.

needs.label: Needs
needs.none: Not filled in by the owner
needs.nothing: Nothing to report, says the owner

publish.title: Publish your care request

points.feed: Your request appears in the feed of nearby sitters.
points.propose: Interested sitters can propose their services.
points.choose: You stay free to choose the sitter who suits you — or nobody.
points.noBooking: Publishing reserves nothing and confirms nothing: no booking, no payment.

publish.needsShared: Your needs and constraints are shown.
publish.privacy: Shown as {{name}}, with the approximate area only. No phone number, surname or address.
publish.duplicateTitle: You have already published this request
publish.duplicateBody: The same animal, service and dates are already open to proposals.
publish.demoBody: The request goes to the sitter feed of this browser — the examples and your own sitter space. Nobody else receives it.

feed.title: Requests near you
feed.intro: Requests published by owners, nearest to your area first.
feed.undeclared: Say which animals you accept to see which requests match.
feed.yours: Your own request, published from your owner space

outside.service: You do not offer this service.
outside.unavailable: You declared yourself unavailable during these dates.

draft.title: Your profile is not visible yet
draft.body: You can read the requests; to propose your services, finish what publishing needs.

hidden.title: Your profile is no longer visible
hidden.body: Something publishing needs was removed. Fill it in again to propose.

feed.demoBody: These requests are examples, plus the ones you published from your owner space on this device. Fitting your profile never means you are available: you decide.

empty.title: No request to show
empty.body: No published request is open right now.
empty.bodyOutside: None matches your profile; see those outside your criteria below.

postDetail.notDeclaredBusy: You have not declared these dates unavailable — that is not a confirmation of availability.
postDetail.breedNotBehaviour: A breed says nothing about behaviour: read the needs above.
postDetail.withdrawBody: The owner will no longer see it. You can propose again later.
postDetail.proposedExample: This is an example request: no owner will read it.
postDetail.proposedOwn: It appears in your owner space, under Requests › Received.
postDetail.exampleBody: No real owner is behind this request. A proposal is kept but read by nobody.
postDetail.ownBody: Published from your owner space on this device. In this prototype both spaces are on the same device, so you can answer yourself to try the whole loop.

cannot.notListed: Your profile must be visible to propose.
cannot.closed: This request no longer accepts proposals.
cannot.animal: This animal is outside what you accept.
cannot.service: You do not offer this service.

propose.title: Propose my services
propose.intro: {{name}} will see your proposal and decide freely.
propose.messageHelp: Your experience with this kind of animal, a question about the needs…
propose.messagePlaceholder: E.g. I have looked after a reactive dog before; can we meet first?
propose.noRate: No rate declared for this service.
propose.noPayment: Proposing commits nobody and asks for no payment.
propose.exampleBody: This is an example request: your proposal will be kept, and no owner will read it.

ownerPost.title: Request for {{name}}
ownerPost.publishedBody: It is visible in the sitter feed of this device. You will find the proposals here and in Requests › Received.
ownerPost.acceptedMeaning: You agreed to arrange this care together. It is not a booking and nothing was paid: the details are for the two of you to settle.
ownerPost.acceptBody: The request closes to new proposals and the others will be marked “not chosen”. It is an agreement to arrange care, not a booking or a payment.
ownerPost.withdrawBody_one: It leaves the sitter feed. {{count}} waiting proposal will be closed.
ownerPost.withdrawBody_other: It leaves the sitter feed. {{count}} waiting proposals will be closed.
ownerPost.simBody: Nobody else uses this device. To try accepting and declining, add a proposal written on behalf of an example sitter whose profile fits. It is labelled as a simulation everywhere.
ownerPost.simNone: No example sitter fits this request (animal, service or dates).
ownerPost.demoBody: This request and its proposals exist in this browser only. Accepting confirms no booking and moves no money.

arrangement.cancelBody: The other person will see that it was cancelled. It stays in your history. Nothing had been paid or booked through Nidz.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.discardBody: The unfinished request is forgotten. A saved animal stays in My animals.

validatedEmpty.title: Nothing confirmed yet
validatedEmpty.body: An accepted request or proposal appears here. Accepting is an agreement between two people, not a booking.

receivedEmpty.title: No proposal received
receivedEmpty.body: Sitters' proposals on your published requests appear here.

owner.directEmpty: You have not written to a sitter yet.
owner.postsEmpty: You have not published a request yet.

sentEmpty.title: No proposal sent
sentEmpty.body: Propose your services on a published request from your feed.

explore.emptyBody: Widen the animal or the service.
explore.fartherNote: From other wilayas, nearest first — an estimate between chefs-lieux, not a distance.

unknown.otherCategory: Animal outside the list: to confirm with the owner
unknown.kindNotGiven: Breed not given, while you accept only some: to confirm
unknown.kindFreeText: Breed in the owner's own words: to confirm

incompatible.category: You do not accept this animal

unknown.otherCategory: Your animal is outside the list: to confirm with the sitter
unknown.kindNotGiven: Accepts only certain breeds: give the breed or ask
unknown.kindFreeText: Breed to confirm with the sitter
